notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
[h1]Changes/Fixes[/h1]

Hello everyone!
Today we are giving you the following changes/fixes:

[list]
[*] The rope now has a texture!
[*] The Swordfish enemy will no longer get stuck behind ropes and do nothing
[*] Swordfish enemy's hitbox has been smaller and more fair
[*] Some more environmental setdressing has beeen added!
[*] Some minor setdressing fixes
[*] When obtaining an upgrade, it now shows a nice graphic along with it!
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
[h1]Thanks to all who played the game![/h1]

Thank you to everyone who has played the game so far, we have loved hearing about how you experienced it so far!
Today we are bringing some minor changes/fixes to the game.

[h1]Changes/Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Music has been added to the intro cinematic
[*] The first Swordfish you encounter has been slightly moved back for a more fair first encounter
[*] Some camera fixes
[*] Flying enemy texture will no longer dissapear when getting hit
[/list]
